convert_moco_to_deit: run the python module to convert a MoCo pre-trained checkpoint to DEiT format
load_moco_checkpoint: run the python module to load a MoCo pre-trained checkpoint from a file path
extract_base_encoder_weights: run the python module to extract base_encoder weights excluding the head layer
save_deit_checkpoint: run the python module to save a converted checkpoint in DEiT format to a specified path
create_output_directory: run the python module to create the output directory if it does not already exist
